library_preparation_preflight.summary: The artifact is an annotation-only API whose Maven metadata already supplies its required dependencies. Meaningful Native Image coverage is reachable by applying its runtime-retained suite annotations to test fixtures and inspecting their values, defaults, inheritance, and repeatable containers.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: No environment variables or system properties are required. Exercise the annotations directly on fixture classes and lifecycle methods. The separate junit-platform-suite-engine is needed only to execute a declarative suite, not to cover the suite-api artifact itself.
risks: Tests that choose to execute an actual @Suite require a version-aligned org.junit.platform:junit-platform-suite-engine and may primarily exercise that separate artifact.
